translation.name: GOT WENG ABEM Alokso Abino Kalin

content: Yesus so Yon wok ban bomin kinim so imi sung uta ko.
Kale Yesus ayo alam weng kidimin kinim kilung kal weng sawa bakayaba uyo banimane, kanaba kabadák tein ei bom nadale Galili abiw abiw ká bom kukuyam bom weng dawkáyam ká bom keimsa.
Kale Yon wok ban bomin kinim ayo sok gei dawtidiw beno, aka weng kidilomane, Yesus ayo kanabano kaliwo, aka alam weng kidimin kinim imbakadala
tad Yesus atam bakodawiw. “Kaba, kinim mak tadokabano, kaliw leiw fenábuw namti, kawtane, bade bá namti, kudá kinim alam tadokaba ami leiw fen bom buduwano.” Akiwe,
Yesus weng atung fakadu bakoyam, “kiba mew kukuw kana bidi utamiw so kidiliw so umi sung uyo asiki yak Yon bakodawino,

kin mat kin bádaba, makal fakanuk gam kidel dauda matam ken tod ká bidiw, wol bán gam kidel imuda kenan bidiw, ken awat awat iyo kilung báyama kidi bidiw, fikalesiw iyo talá imkan bom kei bom nadale Got sung kidel uyo win banim kukaya bom keibano.” Akei nadiwe
weng bakodawin kala. “Kan kinim ata nam kukuw kanodi natama uyo Got aket kudaw nadaw mimin dok di badaw uyo kudálin dakoda namti, ken kalfal bom teinokaba kala, akino.” Yakeisa ko.

Kale Yon weng dew tadbiw kinim iyo imadála uniwe, Yesus ayo dák Yon ami weng fit dew matam dá wanang kinim kanomin teinbiw bakayama ka. “Kiba yak anang iwán sed gisa bakan unemsiw bo watawnak uta utamomu kale unemsiwe? Yak mákal gedul dew tad dáka bada bawlanba beta atamumo, kale unsidiwe?

Bá! Kaliw namti, a utakun uta utamumo, kale unemsiwe? Bade kinim ilim kidel mikiba mok beta bade? Bá, yak ilim kidelok ata tam teinu madák teinu ufek ufek seng kin budusi so keimin be kamok kamok im am dukum kal kutiyábiw.
Kaleyo kiba buta watawnak uta utamumo, kale unemsiwe? Bade lum senin kinim amsun atane? Afan ka, naka atin dam weng bakoyamon, Yon aka atin lum senin kinim bidi akayamsa kinim kate.
Kale lum senin kinim ika ami sung uta buk tem weng bako nadiwe, “naka weng dew kámin kinim mak dabadáli asik kam gebom tadokaba, ata ta bom nadale geboma bom kam leiw kidelokabano.’ Kalesu ko.
Naka atin dam weng bakoyamon, mew wanang man fukanábiw, be mak matam Yon taw so mak keisa bá, kata yak kan kinim ata abid tikin kasák gu kal win banim kei be namti, ata amsun kei Yon akadawsa ko.
Kale Yon wok ban bomin kinim ami wok fokuyámsa atan kalo kudew tad kamano di be Got kasák gu uyo matam fasu kitiduno, kayo kinim wanang iyo ilim kitid kuw tabe kuw mafak dádumo kanamusiw kala.
Kaleyo adikum Lum senin kinim so Mosus weng Sawa so kalo kudew tad bi Yon wok ban bomin kinim di, ika bako nadiw bo kanam tadokaba kalanámsiw.
Kale Yon ami tase be lum senin kinim Ilaitsa tadokabano kalanámsiw kaí, kábe ka.
Kan kinim kawta kenso namti weng bela kidela kidilal kala.
Naka mew kanomin kinim mit tein bidiw imi sung uyo watawo yakokabine? Ika yaknodin tawa? Ikayo ki man katiw katiw abiw dal sung ginan bom tudolawa tudolawa bom nadiwade madik bakodiw,

content.text: ‘nuka wos bidenubuw, kata kiba itol teinin dako bidiw kal bada, nuka lofidinin fuw wemubuw uyo kiba amanin banim dako bidiw, aka akain taw keisiw ko.’

content: Kale Yon wok ban bomin kinim tase ayo imin mak wanongin banim wain wok mak wanongin banim, kata kiba bakodaw nadiwe ‘aka sinik mafak kiwa dausu kala.’ Akansiw.

Kata alo Got ami Kinim tase akal imin wan bom wain wok wan bom kei badane, kiba bakodaw, ‘mew be atamin, aka imin abumin kinim, wok wain seng abumin kinim, aka alaso gawman takis kuámin kinim so ban keimin kinim so im afadow be.’ Akanbiw. Kata Got ami kal keimin uyo kidel. Kale kan kinim ata alam kal keimin weng uyo kidilokaba ata alam kal kei afan kalokaba ko.”
Kol kanomin afan kalongin banim abiw dukum so kuwo kalin sung uta ko.
Kale Yesus ayo abiw dukum dukum kal dubat dubatin kukuw seng uyo kanam kámsa, kata mak ban keimin uyo ibik dumam kudálongin danim kala, kale nadano im fatom dákamin weng bakoyam nadano

kol Kodasin kasel kiwso kuwe, kol Betseidda kasel so kuwe kiba kinkin so keidiw ka. Watawo kaleyo bá, dubat so kukuw uyo kilim kin dim kanamsiw, kata Taya kayak so Saiddon kayak so im kil kal dubat dubatin kukuw uyo ilim kin dim kanamsiw nam, bo ika suwayo kal ban keimin bo ibik dumam nadiwe buso kanamsu kuwo, kale guban am kuntud fu bom kibow banban fakadew bom fatom so keisiwo kalongino bo!
Kata naka bakoyamon, Got ami afung am dánámin uyo Taya kayak so Saiddon kayak so ika idum katiw kuyamokaba, kata kiba amsunim dukum uyo kuyamokaba.

Kale Kabeniyam kayak kiba masi imadew tam abid tikin dádokabano kaloliw? Bá be, sák dalmong yak fikalanámin abiw unokabiw make! Kale dubat dubatin kukuw kim kin dim kanamsi uyo Soddom kal kanamsi nám Soddom uyo kamano kanom buno kalongino bo!
Kata Got ami afung am dánámin dánokabu uyo kim kál funin be dukum kudulokabiw, kata Soddom kayak ika kál funin katiw so kudulokabiw ko.”
Tad nalaso nadiwo finudin kalin sung uta ko.

Kale kana bom bakaba kabadákal Yesus ayo bako nadale, “nalam Natim, abid so bakan so Kamokim kaba, naka win kufokami, be watawo kaleyo bá, kaba kanodin kukuw uyo yak win tabin iyo kin kuwáyam nadawe yak win banim imi dim kal kuw misun teibaw.
Au, Natim ken kei bula kalawta kanoduko, kalbaw kayo ko!”

Kale Yesus ayo bakoyam nadale, “mew ufek ufek adikum bo nalam Natim alata bámadá kudála maek nalam teng ban dim abesu, kata yaknodin kinim ata mak Min ami mit be kal keidoliw banim, kata alam Min makuw ata kuw alam kal ade kinim kan ita Min alata walu imuda ita kuw Alaw ayo daw misun teiyama atamokabiw ko.
Adikum yak kan kawta aket luklakin so idum dukum so kudew tadbaw namti, tad nalata natamiwo, naka dakoyam finuyámin kuyamon kala.
Kiba nalaso ká bom nadiwe nam weng kidi abo kudew tabin kala. Watawo kaleyo bá, naka kinim kidel, aket dakbudin kinim kale kiba tad natamiwo kibilim aket dakbuyámin uyo utamokabiw, kál finudokabiw.
Kiba naso kámin uyo fitin leiw bá, ade nam kukuw uyo kalfong ko.”
